value.rationale: This analytically sharp test reveals the otherwise hidden distinction between continuous dissipativity, numerical one-step mean-square contractivity and asymptotic mean-square stability. Crossing theta=1/2 changes the safe-step geometry, and a pathwise two-step zero coexists with unbounded first-step expected amplification. These phenomena give meaningful exact barriers for interpreting stiff stochastic numerical updates, beyond a routine single substitution; no generalized numerical accuracy is asserted.
